note: The catalogue of lettering treatments. The machine-readable authority is this file; each template's own `template.md` holds the paragraph that is copied into the prompt. A template's reference image is loaded as the image's single `lettering` + `typography` reference so the model sees the treatment instead of guessing it.
rules: Pick one template per image and keep it for every panel of that image.
Every panel needs at least one core_text line, caption or sound effect; a silent panel is not allowed.
Never let lettering cover a face, a hand, the acting gesture or a panel border.
The reference fixes the treatment only; the wording comes from core_text and is never copied from the reference.

02_burst-shout.label: Burst shout
02_burst-shout.use_for: a shouted line, an accusation or sudden anger

04_caption-box.label: Caption box
04_caption-box.use_for: narration, time and place, the story's own voice

05_manga-impact.label: Manga impact
05_manga-impact.use_for: one extreme beat on the page

08_sfx-style.label: Sound effect
08_sfx-style.use_for: drawn sound effects such as a slam or a crash
